Lorenz curves: how concentrated is scoring?

Source: R/teams.R
plot_lorenz.Rd

Several teams on one panel (instead of one panel per team), each curve labelled directly with its Gini coefficient, plus the line of equality. The area between the diagonal and a curve is the inequality.

Usage

plot_lorenz(
  data,
  value,
  group,
  n = 8,
  highlight = NULL,
  value_label = NULL,
  title = NULL,
  subtitle = NULL,
  caption = NULL
)

Arguments

data

Player-level data.

value

Column to analyse (e.g. "pts").

group

Column identifying teams.

n

Top-n players per team (same n for every team).

highlight

Groups to colour; others grey. Default: the most equal team and the two most top-heavy.

value_label

How to name value on the axis (e.g. "points").

title, subtitle, caption

Labels.

Examples

nba <- subset(player_seasons, league == "NBA")
plot_lorenz(nba, "pts", "team", highlight = c("OKC", "MIL", "BKN"))
